title.narrative: Minimizing the impact of the COVID-19 outbreak in Georgia through telemedicine and digital health solutions

description.narrative: UNOPS is working alongside UNFPA, UNICEF and the World Health Organization to mitigate the disruption of health services in rural areas of Georgia caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. As part of a project led by the UN Country Team, UNOPS will procure basic equipment and furniture for 200 village healthcare facilities as well as equipment used for telemedicine and telecare for 50 remote areas to support doctors in rural areas with providing quality health services, using $1.7 million in funding from the European Union.
